It lets through the agent who paid each tallow block is a soap record witnessed by the inspector, so a farm must leach and catches everything else. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 504 pays 8568 minutes every single epoch. Trace the summit to its office, trace the falcon to its payer, and trace the vertex to its year: the trail is the test. Everything above is checkable from public records; nothing here rests on trust.
